subject: french

rounds.why: False friend — “actuellement” means “currently / at the moment”. “Actually” is “en fait”.

truths: “Faire les valises” means “to pack the suitcases”.

rounds.lie: “Je vis en banlieue” means “I live in the city centre”.
rounds.why: “La banlieue” means “the suburbs/outskirts”. “City centre” is “le centre-ville”.
rounds.truth: “Je vis en banlieue” means “I live in the suburbs”.
truths: “Il y a beaucoup de pollution” means “There is a lot of pollution”.

rounds.lie: “On devrait recycler davantage” means “We recycled more”.
rounds.why: “On devrait” is the conditional “we should”; “davantage” = “more”. “We recycled” is “on a recyclé”.
rounds.truth: “On devrait recycler davantage” means “We should recycle more”.

rounds.lie: “Le train est en retard” means “The train is early”.
rounds.truth: “Le train est en retard” means “The train is late/delayed”.
truths: “Réserver une chambre double” means “to book a double room”.

rounds.why: “Le covoiturage” means “car-sharing/carpooling”. A traffic jam is “un embouteillage”.
truths: “Il faut protéger la planète” means “We must protect the planet”.
“L'année prochaine je voyagerai” means “Next year I will travel”.
“Trier les déchets” means “to sort the waste”.
